originalTitle: Hershey (HSY) Gains As Market Dips: What You Should Know
summary: The latest trading day saw Hershey (HSY) settling at $174.34, representing a +1.25% change from its previous close.
content:
In the latest trading session, Hershey (HSY) closed at $174.34, marking a +1.25% move from the previous day. This move outpaced the S&P 500's daily loss of 0.59%. At the same time, the Dow lost 0.6%, and the tech-heavy Nasdaq lost 0.65%.

The stock of chocolate bar and candy maker has fallen by 6.54% in the past month, lagging the Consumer Staples sector's loss of 2.41% and the S&P 500's loss of 1.37%.

Market participants will be closely following the financial results of Hershey in its upcoming release. In that report, analysts expect Hershey to post earnings of $2.11 per share. This would mark year-over-year growth of 62.31%. In the meantime, our current consensus estimate forecasts the revenue to be $3.26 billion, indicating a 2.34% growth compared to the corresponding quarter of the prior year.

For the entire fiscal year, the Zacks Consensus Estimates are projecting earnings of $8.49 per share and a revenue of $12.29 billion, representing changes of +34.55% and +5.13%, respectively, from the prior year.

It is also important to note the recent changes to analyst estimates for Hershey. These revisions typically reflect the latest short-term business trends, which can change frequently. With this in mind, we can consider positive estimate revisions a sign of optimism about the business outlook.

Our research demonstrates that these adjustments in estimates directly associate with imminent stock price performance. To benefit from this, we have developed the Zacks Rank, a proprietary model which takes these estimate changes into account and provides an actionable rating system.

The Zacks Rank system, running from #1 (Strong Buy) to #5 (Strong Sell), holds an admirable track record of superior performance, independently audited, with #1 stocks contributing an average annual return of +25% since 1988. Within the past 30 days, our consensus EPS projection has moved 0.07% higher. Hershey presently features a Zacks Rank of #3 (Hold).

Looking at its valuation, Hershey is holding a Forward P/E ratio of 20.29. This indicates a premium in contrast to its industry's Forward P/E of 20.03.

We can also see that HSY currently has a PEG ratio of 1.36. This metric is used similarly to the famous P/E ratio, but the PEG ratio also takes into account the stock's expected earnings growth rate. The average PEG ratio for the Food - Confectionery industry stood at 1.36 at the close of the market yesterday.

The Food - Confectionery industry is part of the Consumer Staples sector. With its current Zacks Industry Rank of 224, this industry ranks in the bottom 9% of all industries, numbering over 250.

The Zacks Industry Rank assesses the vigor of our specific industry groups by computing the average Zacks Rank of the individual stocks incorporated in the groups. Our research shows that the top 50% rated industries outperform the bottom half by a factor of 2 to 1.

Keep in mind to rely on Zacks.com to watch all these stock-impacting metrics, and more, in the succeeding trading sessions.

chineseTitle: 好时 (HSY) 随着市场下跌而上涨：您应该知道什么
chineseSummary: 最新交易日好时 (HSY) 收于 174.34 美元，较前收盘价上涨 1.25%。
chineseContent:
在最近的交易日中，好时 (HSY) 收于 174.34 美元，较前一交易日上涨 1.25%。这一举措超过了标准普尔 500 指数 0.59% 的日跌幅。与此同时，道指下跌 0.6%，以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数下跌 0.65%。

过去一个月，巧克力和糖果制造商的股价下跌了 6.54%，落后于必需消费品板块 2.41% 的跌幅和标准普尔 500 指数 1.37% 的跌幅。

市场参与者将密切关注好时即将发布的财务业绩。在那份报告中，分析师预计好时公司将公布每股收益 2.11 美元。这将标志着同比增长 62.31%。与此同时，我们目前的共识预测收入为 32.6 亿美元，比去年同期增长 2.34%。

对于整个财年，Zacks 一致预期预计每股收益为 8.49 美元，营收为 122.9 亿美元，较上一年分别变化 +34.55% 和 +5.13%。

同样重要的是要注意好时分析师估计的最新变化。这些修订通常反映最新的短期业务趋势，这些趋势可能经常变化。考虑到这一点，我们可以认为积极的估计修正是对业务前景乐观的迹象。

我们的研究表明，这些预估调整与即将到来的股价表现直接相关。为了从中受益，我们开发了 Zacks Rank，这是一种专有模型，它考虑了这些估计变化并提供了可行的评级系统。

Zacks Rank 系统从#1（强力买入）到#5（强力卖出），拥有令人钦佩的卓越业绩记录，经过独立审计，自 1988 年以来，#1 股票贡献的平均年回报率为 +25%。在过去 30 天内，我们的共识 EPS 预测上升了 0.07%。好时目前的 Zacks 排名为#3（持有）。

从估值来看，好时的远期市盈率为 20.29。与该行业 20.03 的远期市盈率相比，这表明存在溢价。

我们还可以看到HSY目前的PEG比率为1.36。该指标的使用方式与著名的市盈率类似，但 PEG 比率还考虑了股票的预期盈利增长率。昨天收盘时，食品糖果行业的平均 PEG 率为 1.36。

食品 - 糖果行业是必需消费品行业的一部分。该行业目前的 Zacks 行业排名为 224，在所有行业中排名垫底 9%，数量超过 250 个。

Zacks 行业排名通过计算特定行业组中个股的平均 Zacks 排名来评估我们特定行业组的活力。我们的研究表明，排名前 50% 的行业的表现比排名后一半的行业高出 2 比 1。
